core_obligations: Normalize the coefficients: F is annihilated by some n > 0, and replacing Lambda by Lambda/nLambda leaves Rf_!F unchanged, so assume Lambda is a torsion ring (proof lines 4877-4879).
Descend to the Noetherian case: write Y = Spec(R) as a union of finite type Z-subalgebras, descend F by the colimit lemma, and assume Y is Noetherian of finite dimension (proof lines 4882-4887).

Prove the base case d = 0: identify the stalks of R^qf_!F with the compact cohomology of the geometric fibre by the stalk lemma and conclude finiteness from the curve finiteness lemma (proof lines 4894-4899).

Prove the induction step: reduce to a dense open V via base change compatibility; take the dense open U on which F is finite type locally constant, note the complement Z is generically finite over the generic points, shrink Y so Z to Y is finite, discard Z through the relative triangle and the quasi-finite constructibility lemma, and conclude by the locally constant case lemma (proof lines 4902-4924).
proof_roadmap: Coefficient normalization and Noetherian descent (proof lines 4877-4887).
Base case via compact cohomology of fibres (proof lines 4894-4899).
Induction step: locally constant split, finite complement, and the terminal case (proof lines 4902-4924).
